en.headline: Watches and cash taken in Repulse Bay Road burglary
en.dek: A 25-year-old woman reported a bedroom window forced open on Friday night; police said three watches worth about HK$437,000 and about RMB20,000 were missing.
body: Police are investigating a burglary at a unit on Repulse Bay Road after a 25-year-old woman reported at about 11.43pm on Friday that a bedroom window had been forced and the flat searched.

Officers who attended found that three watches with a combined estimated value of about HK$437,000, together with about RMB20,000 in cash, were missing. Local media identified the watches as Rolex and Breguet models. Police said the resident was still checking the full extent of the loss.

The case has been classified as burglary and assigned to Western District’s criminal investigation team. No one had been arrested as of Saturday morning. Reports placed the unit in a residential development at 5 Repulse Bay Road.

zh.headline: 淺水灣道單位遭爆竊 失約44萬元手錶及人民幣
zh.dek: 25歲女子周五深夜報案，指睡房窗戶被撬、屋內有搜掠痕迹；警方初步點算失3隻手錶及約2萬元人民幣，暫未有人被捕。
body: 警方正調查一宗淺水灣道爆竊案。一名25歲女子周五晚上約11時43分報案，指住所一間睡房的窗戶被撬開，屋內有搜掠痕迹，懷疑有人入屋爆竊。
警員到場後初步點算，單位內共有3隻估計總值約43.7萬港元的手錶，以及約2萬元人民幣現金不翼而飛。本地傳媒指被竊手錶包括勞力士及寶瑤。警方表示事主仍在點算實際損失。
案件列作爆竊，交由西區警區刑事調查隊跟進，至周六早上暫未有人被捕。報道指單位位於淺水灣道5號一個住宅屋苑。
